description: A terrestrial photograph depicting a mountainous landscape with distinct land cover types delineated. A prominent orange dashed line indicates the "Tree line", separating forested slopes from open grasslands. Above this tree line, the higher elevation areas are identified as "Alpine grasslands – 4.2.2". Below the tree line, the lower green slopes are labelled "Mountain hay meadows (Semi-natural grasslands without woods plants) – 4.2.1.2". A white road is visible in the foreground, traversing through the lower grassland area. The image is sourced from "©European Union, 2012" and "LUCAS" (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey).
